pick:bounce.name: Bounce
pick:bounce.what: Hops in place a few times.

pick:peekaboo.name: Peekaboo
pick:peekaboo.what: Drops out of sight, then pops back up.

pick:zoomies.name: Zoomies
pick:zoomies.what: Races back and forth along the taskbar.

pick:nap.name: Nap anywhere
pick:nap.what: Curls up wherever it is and sleeps for a bit.

pick:sit.name: Sit
pick:sit.what: Sits down for a while and looks around.

pick:lie.name: Lie down
pick:lie.what: Lies down on its side and dozes.

pick:spin.name: Spin
pick:spin.what: Turns all the way around, twice.

pick:wave.name: Wave
pick:wave.what: Waves hello when you arrive, and whenever you ask.

pick:dab.name: Dab
pick:dab.what: Drops a dab. Head down, arm out.

pick:moonwalk.name: Moonwalk
pick:moonwalk.what: Slides backwards along the taskbar, facing the wrong way.

pick:rot.name: Rot
pick:rot.what: Lies face down for a while and refuses to get up. A click gets it up, grumbling.

pick:spinout.name: Spin out
pick:spinout.what: Spins faster and faster, gets dizzy, staggers, flops.

pick:faint.name: Faint
pick:faint.what: A dramatic collapse. Recovers on its own and insists it's fine.

pick:sideeye.name: Side-eye
pick:sideeye.what: Turns away and gives you a look. Says nothing helpful.

pick:backflip.name: Backflip
pick:backflip.what: A jump with a full turn in the air and a squash on landing.

pick:sneak.name: Sneak
pick:sneak.what: Tiptoes along, crouched, looking around. Shh.

pick:panic.name: Panic
pick:panic.what: Runs back and forth screaming about nothing.

pick:meditate.name: Meditate
pick:meditate.what: Sits, closes its eyes, and floats a little. Ohm.

pick:loaf.name: Loaf
pick:loaf.what: Tucks everything in and becomes a loaf for a while.

pick:bow.name: Take a bow
pick:bow.what: A deep bow. Thank you, thank you.

pick:stare.name: Stare
pick:stare.what: Stares at you. Does not blink. For a while.

pick:jumpscare.name: Jumpscare
pick:jumpscare.what: Turns into a folder, waits, then jumps out at you. Boo.

pick:yoga.name: Yoga
pick:yoga.what: Stretch, sit, lie down, breathe. Namaste.

pick:sneeze.name: Sneeze
pick:sneeze.what: A big wind-up and an achoo that moves it a step.

pick:parkour.name: Parkour
pick:parkour.what: Hops along the taskbar and back like it's a rooftop.

pick:chase.name: Chase the cursor
pick:chase.what: Runs after your cursor for a few seconds.

pick:homework.name: Homework
pick:homework.what: Opens the laptop, sighs, nods off, wakes up.

pick:statue.name: Statue
pick:statue.what: Freezes mid-pose for a while. Do not touch the art.

pick:study.name: Study with me
pick:study.what: Sits down with a laptop and a book and keeps you company. Click it when you're done.

pick:work.name: Work with me
pick:work.what: Sits down with a laptop and a mug and keeps you company. Click it when you're done.

pick:game.name: Game with me
pick:game.what: Headphones on, controller out, plays alongside you. Click it when you're done.

pick:eat.name: Eat with me
pick:eat.what: Brings a bowl and eats when you eat. Click it when you're done.

pick:clingy.name: Clingy
pick:clingy.what: Drifts toward your mouse. Misses you faster.

pick:showoff.name: Show-off
pick:showoff.what: Does tricks on its own, more often.
